title: hieracium subhirtum
intro: Hieracium subhirtum, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium subhirtum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
